chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 401: The Bloodcloud Hall’s Price – Ji Ning Faces an Assassination Contract
chapter_meta_description: Ancestor Mysterious Mystic pays three top-grade Immortal treasures to mark Ji Ning for death within a year. Meanwhile, Ji Ning visits his cousin in the Imperial Capital and meets a dangerous rival from the Heavenly Realm.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch 401 – The Bloodcloud Hall’s Price
og_description: A Celestial Immortal pays a king’s ransom for Ji Ning’s head, while a new political rival emerges from the Heavenly Realm.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch 401 – A Price in Blood
twitter_description: Three treasures for a death warrant. An arrogant prince. Ji Ning walks into a social minefield.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary assassin guild operating across the Three Realms, known for its ruthless efficiency and willingness to take on even the most dangerous contracts for a sufficient price.
A Celestial Immortal of the Shaoyin clan, willing to pay an enormous price to eliminate the rising threat of Ji Ning.
The highest grade of magic treasure below the Pure Yang level, invaluable even to Celestial Immortals for both offense and defense.
Ji Ning’s maternal cousin, a princess of the Grand Xia Dynasty, who has sworn to rebuild her fallen Yuchi clan.
The official title of Yuchi Xiyue, Ji Ning’s cousin, who rules the Yan Estate in the Grand Xia Imperial Capital.
A minor power in the Heavenly Realm, currently allied with the Grand Xia Dynasty through a marriage pact.
An arrogant son of the Island Lord of Windbinding Island, a Earth Immortal-level cultivator who openly pursues Yuchi Xiyue.
A humble, inferior young man from Windbinding Island, willing to marry into Yuchi Xiyue’s clan.
A cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and lifelong commitment; more than a romantic spouse, often used in the context of political alliances.
